principle: Distinguish exhaustive deterministic slices, development holdouts, independent blind holdouts, synthetic stress cases and proxy-weighted summaries. Do not report percentages without denominators and evidence role.

first_natural_holdout.role: development evidence; opened before final 3-slot/4-slot fusion choice

second_blind_holdout.role: independent validation frozen before candidate outputs were generated
second_blind_holdout.interpretation: Strong evidence that G1-4slot improves Hit@5 over C0 on this frozen benchmark distribution; the absolute 85% rate remains imprecisely estimated because n=20.

canonical_regression.role: fixed deterministic regression set, not a random production sample
canonical_regression.interpretation: Zero observed regression on these 617 frozen cases. Do not convert this mechanically into a production-population confidence claim.

weighted_metrics.weight_semantics: historical occurrence proxy, not sampling probability for production description queries
weighted_metrics.classical_confidence_interval: not reported without a defensible sampling/variance model

scope_limits: target space is the 316-skill P80 priority envelope, not all 6752 active skills
blind descriptions come from AF labour-market-training text and may differ from real user free text
second blind holdout contains only 20 cases
each blind case has exactly one P80 target by construction, so multi-intent user descriptions are underrepresented
post-residual experiments after opening the second holdout are exploratory and require a new independent holdout before candidate promotion
synthetic stress cases are instrumentation, not population evidence

exhaustive_or_deterministic_slices: YV exact multi-context population: 541/541 IDs evaluated
YV deterministic one-edit typo stress: 1076 mutations across 541 multi-context IDs
YV generator-excluded title population: all 205 active excluded titles evaluated
strict current canonical alias populations: 357 YV aliases and 1279 KV aliases
track1_reporting_classes.interpretation: These are defined-slice enumerations rather than random samples; sampling confidence intervals are not the main uncertainty. External-validity and traffic-distribution uncertainty still remain.

reporting_rule: Every headline metric must include numerator/denominator (or population size), evidence role, scope, and confidence interval when a genuine sample-based proportion is being generalized. Proxy-weighted metrics must be labelled descriptive unless a valid variance model exists.
